C0407.title: Uber and Cisco Breaches via Push Bombing
C0407.summary: Push bombing, also known as MFA fatigue, appeared in incidents involving Uber, Cisco, and other organizations. Attackers repeatedly sent large numbers of multi-factor authentication push notifications to users, inducing or pressuring them to approve one request and thereby granting unauthorized access. These cases show that MFA flows relying only on push approval can still be bypassed under persistent harassment and social engineering.
